description: A muted dusty russet-red knee-length wool tunic with a simple rounded slit collar and restrained narrow oatmeal-and-brown woven trim at neckline and cuffs, a cream linen long-sleeved undershirt, a plain sturdy brown leather belt, dark grey-brown wool trousers, oatmeal leg wraps and soft dark-brown leather shoes. Practical civilian early medieval Scandinavian landowner attire, modest prosperous woven cloth with light everyday wear. No headgear, armor, weapons, fur war gear, crowns, heraldry or elaborate jewelry.
